listen_addresses.description: List of network addresses and ports the server listens on for DHCP requests.

host.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4, [::] for all IPv6, or a specific IP).

port.description: UDP port number (typically 67 for DHCP server).

plugins.description: Ordered list of plugins to enable, with optional space-separated arguments.

name.description: Name of the plugin (e.g., serverid, file, range, hosts).

args.description: List of arguments passed to the plugin (if any).

static_hosts.description: Static host entries for fixed MAC → IP assignments (optional).

hostname.description: Optional hostname to assign to the device.

lease_file.description: Path to the file where active DHCP leases are persisted (enables lease continuity across restarts). Leave empty to disable persistence.

shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait during shutdown for in-progress requests to complete before force-exiting.
